name: pmg-score-with-rice
description: Scores a backlog with RICE into a scored backlog with confidence notes, out-of-order exceptions and a cut list. Use for "run pmg-score-with-rice", "RICE score my backlog", "prioritise my backlog", "rank these features", "too many requests and not enough capacity", "the loudest voice keeps winning", "what do we cut this quarter", "reach impact confidence effort", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
